line_check.method: Matched original nonempty source lines against #line coordinates, including inactive boundaries and comments. Existing mismatches listed explicitly.

decision: R1424: retain one release at the failed loader return. No ownership transfer occurs after the parameter copy. Switching to a common label would modify both return and cleanup sites. Moving allocation after DLL loading would extend a guest flat-pointer lifetime across that boundary.

verification.control: Ran the loader-failure fixture with current prefixes and again with just WG32GetEnvironment from pinned OpenNT. Current: 72 checks, 0 failures. Original: 72 checks, 3 failures, all on copied-parameter release. Both retained the zero return.
verification.scope: Exact production prefixes and bounded allocation/loader doubles, not a real printer job.
